methodology: Provenance-preserving reconciliation of already-screened PR #286. Leads are unverified, not public source locators. No new screening or critical-text verification. Canonical 6,236-ayah union remains outstanding.

records.topic: God-conscious people remember when touched by satanic suggestion

unverified_research_leads.difference: James commands submission to God and resistance to the devil; Qur'an 7:201 describes an episode of satanic prompting followed by remembrance and restored insight.

records.pending_question: Compare the Greek wording and assess whether earlier Jewish temptation/remembrance literature is closer; no identification of direct borrowing.

records.topic: Satanic brothers extend others in error without relenting
records.pending_question: Determine antecedent of 'their brothers' in Arabic and tafsir before searching for a precise pre-Islamic textual analogue; broad demonology alone is not sufficient.

records.topic: Demand for a sign and prophetic adherence to revelation
records.pending_question: Distinguish demands for a miracle from demands for an invented recitation; identify a genuinely corresponding earlier narrative before proposing a link.

records.topic: Listen attentively when the Qur'an is recited

unverified_research_leads.difference: Nehemiah narrates a public reading and explanation of Torah to an assembled community; Qur'an 7:204 issues a general instruction to listen quietly during recitation.

records.pending_question: Check Hebrew narrative and historical setting; determine whether listening-in-silence is explicitly prescribed in the passage, rather than inferred.

records.topic: Remember God humbly inwardly morning and evening

unverified_research_leads.difference: Psalm 1 describes meditation on divine instruction day and night; Qur'an 7:205 enjoins humble remembrance of the Lord at morning and evening.
Psalm 63 mentions remembrance on the bed and meditation during watches of the night; Qur'an specifies morning and evening and avoidance of heedlessness.

records.pending_question: Check Hebrew numbering and wording, Psalm 63 superscription/dating, and avoid equating meditation on Torah with Qur'anic dhikr.
